snippet.title: Moorfall – Gameplay Trailer | Real-Time Strategy | Coming to Steam 2027
snippet.description:
Moorfall is a real-time strategy game. Lead your captains across the moor, take the villages and drive Schwarzmoor out of Grimmwald – village by village.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5203000/Moorfall/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer

No base building, no resource clicking. Your soldiers are the people of the villages you hold: outnumber a village and it surrenders, call its volunteers to arms, and march on before the enemy takes it back. Beyond what your captains can see lies the fog – villages you have not found, armies you have not met, and four banners fighting over one moor.

The new trailer shows the reworked world: hills and snow-capped mountains, frozen lakes and winter maps, waves on the shore, and a moor full of life – villagers at work, traders with horse and cart, deer, chickens and scout ravens.

Coming to Steam in 2027. Full English and German.


#Moorfall #indiegame #strategygame
